note: Hidden test-fixture submodule. Provides the test_sensor SensorPlugin (State-driven) and installs test monitoring_sensor_config entities (test_sensor, test_sensor_exceeds [thresholds.type=exceeds], test_sensor_falls, test_sensor_inner, test_sensor_outer, test_sensor_cat_watchdog, ...), a TestWorker queue worker and a TestSensorResult class. Baseline: submodule not enabled. Medium cases enable it and read the shipped sensor configs back; hard cases install the fixture (reset uninstalls, verify checks module enabled + test_sensor config exists). Grounded in real shipped config (plugin_id: test_sensor, test_sensor_exceeds thresholds.type: exceeds).

evals.prompt: What is the purpose of the monitoring_test submodule, and what controllable sensor plugin does it provide?
evals.expected_output: It is a hidden test-fixture module for Monitoring's automated tests. It provides the test_sensor SensorPlugin whose status/value/message are driven by State (monitoring_test.sensor_result_data), plus ready-made test sensor configs.

evals.prompt: The monitoring_test module ships sensor configs for exercising each threshold type. Name some of the threshold comparison types its test sensors cover.
evals.expected_output: Its shipped test sensors cover exceeds (test_sensor_exceeds), falls (test_sensor_falls), inner (test_sensor_inner) and outer (test_sensor_outer).

evals.prompt: How does a test control what status/value the monitoring_test test_sensor reports?
evals.expected_output: TestSensorPlugin reads the State key monitoring_test.sensor_result_data (sensor_status, sensor_value, sensor_message, sensor_expected_value, sensor_exception_message), so a test sets that State to force any outcome.

evals.prompt: The monitoring_test module is installed on this site. Inspect the live configuration of its test_sensor_exceeds sensor and report the threshold comparison type it uses.
With monitoring_test installed, inspect the live 'test_sensor' sensor configuration on this site and report which sensor plugin (plugin_id) it uses.
evals.expected_output: The test_sensor sensor config uses plugin_id: test_sensor (monitoring.sensor_config.test_sensor).

evals.prompt: Install the monitoring_test fixture module on this site so its test sensors (such as test_sensor) are available.
evals.expected_output: monitoring_test is installed (drush en monitoring_test) and the monitoring.sensor_config.test_sensor entity exists.

evals.prompt: I want to try out the Monitoring module's built-in example sensors that are used for testing. Please set up those test sensors on my site.
evals.expected_output: Enabling monitoring_test installs its fixture sensor configs (test_sensor and friends); the module is installed and monitoring.sensor_config.test_sensor exists.
